login.subtitle: Enter your PIN to start a shift
login.keyboardHint: Tap the keypad or type on the keyboard

cart.heading: Current Order
cart.empty: Tap a product to add it to the order.

checkout.heading: Checkout
checkout.noBanks: No banks set up - add them in Settings → KHQR to show a QR code to the customer.
checkout.cardNote: Take the card payment on the card terminal, then press Complete Payment.

network.offlineMessage: You're offline. Orders will save locally and sync automatically.

salesHistory.heading: Sales History
salesHistory.pendingNote: {count} offline order(s) not synced yet - they will appear here once synced.

orderDetail.voidConfirmTitle: Void this order? This cannot be undone.

general.storeNameHint: This branch's name on this register's header, receipts and customer display. Leave empty to use "{default}".
general.languageHint: Language used on this register's screens and receipts.
general.appearanceHint: Light or dark screens, or follow this computer's setting. Also applies to the customer display.

printer.hint: Receipts print here automatically after each sale. Saved on this register only.
printer.paperSizeHint: Match the width of the receipt roll in this register's printer. If an 80 mm printer cuts off the right edge of receipts, choose 64 mm. Saved on this register only.
printer.bottomMarginHint: Blank paper fed after each receipt. Increase it if the last line gets torn off; decrease it if there's too much blank paper. Saved on this register only.

test.heading: Test receipt
test.hint: Preview of a receipt with the settings above: same layout and line breaks as the printout, including the bottom margin. Print it to check alignment and that nothing gets torn off.
test.printed: Test receipt sent to the printer.
test.noPrinter: Choose a receipt printer above to print a test.
test.label: TEST PRINT

payments.methodsHint: Methods shown at checkout on this register. Turn off any this till can't take. Saved on this register only.
payments.lastMethod: At least one payment method must stay on.

khqr.intro: Add each bank you accept Mobile Pay through, with its KHQR code. The cashier picks the bank at checkout and the customer screen shows its QR.
khqr.addError: Couldn't add the bank. Check the file is an image and try again.

about.updatesHint: Updates also install automatically when the app starts.
about.updatesDisabled: Updates are turned off in development builds.
about.installing: Downloading and installing - the app will restart.
